bio: The Duke of Cambridge is a family-friendly, traditional village pub in Tilford, near Farnham, with a passion for local food and drink.  Indulge in one of Britain’s most loved traditions with Afternoon Tea in the warming surrounds of the restaurant. A delectable selection of sweet treats and savoury delights await, complete with freshly baked scones, clotted cream and preserves.  The Duke offers a variety of dining spaces, full of character and charm, the perfect setting to sit back, relax and enjoy Afternoon Tea.  Afternoon Tea is available Monday to Saturday from 12pm to 5pm. Advance booking is recommended.
